title: FROM ASSUMPTIONS TO ACTIONS: TURNING LLM REASONING INTO UNCERTAINTY-AWARE PLANNING FOR EMBODIED AGENTS
reasoning: The paper focuses on a planning framework (PCE) for embodied agents using LLMs to handle environmental uncertainty. It evaluates performance based on task success and efficiency. While it mentions 'trustworthy' communication patterns in its user study, this is in the context of human-agent collaboration reliability and coordination, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
